title: Psalm emits this issue when a constant declared as final is overridden in a child class or interface.
summary: Psalm ignores it at error level 7 and higher.

title: Psalm emits this issue when a property declared as final is redeclared in a child class.
summary: Properties declared with private(set) asymmetric visibility are implicitly final. Psalm ignores it at error level 7 and higher.

title: Psalm emits this issue when a constant declared on an interface is overridden by a child (illegal in PHP < 8.1).
summary: Psalm ignores it at error level 7 and higher.

title: Psalm emits this issue when a method is less accessible than its parent.
summary: Psalm ignores it at error level 8.

title: Psalm emits this issue when a property is less accessible than the same-named property in its parent class.
summary: Psalm reports it at each error level.
